sentences.zh: 石頭是無生命的物體,不像植物或動物。

sentences.zh: 孩子們幻想這些沒有生命的玩具在夜裡活了過來。

sentences.en: She faced the criticism with remarkable ______.
sentences.zh: 她以驚人的鎮定態度面對這些批評。

sentences.en: Despite the chaos around him, he maintained his ______.
sentences.zh: 儘管周遭一片混亂,他依然保持著平靜的心態。

sentences.en: The winning team was ______ in victory, praising their opponents.
sentences.zh: 獲勝的隊伍在勝利時展現出寬宏大量,對對手大加讚賞。

sentences.en: It was ______ of her to forgive him so quickly.
sentences.zh: 她這麼快就原諒了他,實在是非常寬宏大量。

sentences.en: Years of competition had bred deep ______ between the two companies.
sentences.zh: 多年的競爭在這兩家公司之間滋生了深深的敵意。

sentences.en: The ______ between the siblings stemmed from an old family dispute.
sentences.zh: 這對兄弟姊妹之間的仇恨源自於一場舊有的家族糾紛。

words.root_note: animus (mind) + advertere (to turn toward), from Latin

sentences.en: The critic's review was full of sharp ______ against the director's choices.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家的影評充滿了對導演選擇的尖銳批評。

sentences.en: He accepted the harsh ______ from his editor without complaint.
sentences.zh: 他毫無怨言地接受了編輯嚴厲的批評。

words.defn_en: to criticize or comment on something critically:
words.root_note: animus (mind) + advertere (to turn toward), from Latin

sentences.en: The columnist did not hesitate to ______ on the mayor's questionable spending.
sentences.zh: 這位專欄作家毫不猶豫地批評市長可疑的支出。

sentences.en: Reviewers ______ freely on every flaw in the debut novel.
sentences.zh: 評論家對這部處女作的每個缺點都毫不留情地加以批評。

words.defn_en: to bring to life or give energy to; alive or lively:

sentences.en: The director's passion seemed to ______ every scene of the film.
sentences.zh: 導演的熱情似乎為電影的每一幕都注入了生命力。

sentences.en: Her enthusiasm could ______ even the dullest committee meeting.
sentences.zh: 她的熱情能讓最沉悶的委員會會議也活絡起來。

sentences.en: The children watched their favorite ______ movie for the tenth time.
sentences.zh: 孩子們第十次觀看他們最喜歡的動畫電影。

sentences.en: Her ______ storytelling kept the whole class engaged.
sentences.zh: 她生動活潑的說故事方式讓全班學生都聽得入迷。

words.defn_en: giving life, energy, or spirit to something:

sentences.en: Curiosity was the ______ force behind her decades of research.
sentences.zh: 好奇心是驅動她數十年研究工作的活力泉源。

sentences.en: The coach's ______ speech turned the team's mood around completely.
sentences.zh: 教練充滿活力的講話,徹底扭轉了球隊的士氣。

words.defn_en: liveliness and enthusiasm; the technique of creating moving images from drawings:

sentences.en: She described the trip with such ______ that everyone wanted to visit immediately.
sentences.zh: 她描述這趟旅行時神采飛揚,讓每個人都想立刻動身前往。

sentences.en: The studio spent five years perfecting the film's hand-drawn ______.
sentences.zh: 這家片廠花了五年時間打磨這部電影手繪動畫的細節。

words.defn_en: hostility or ill feeling; a motivating force:

sentences.en: The lawsuit alleged the firing was driven by personal ______ rather than performance.
sentences.zh: 這起訴訟指稱解雇的原因是出於私人恩怨,而非工作表現。

sentences.en: Despite decades of rivalry, the two coaches showed no visible ______ toward each other.
sentences.zh: 儘管競爭了數十年,這兩位教練彼此之間看不出明顯的敵意。

words.defn_en: a rare term relating to calmness or tranquility of mind:
words.root_note: possibly related to Latin lenis (gentle) + animus (mind)

sentences.en: Years of meditation brought her a deep sense of ______ .
sentences.zh: 多年的冥想為她帶來了一種深沉的內心平靜。

sentences.en: He faced the crisis with remarkable ______ , never losing his composure.
sentences.zh: 他以驚人的心靈平靜面對這場危機,從未失去鎮定。

sentences.en: She endured years of hardship with remarkable ______ .
sentences.zh: 她以驚人的堅忍耐性度過了多年的艱難時光。

sentences.en: His ______ toward difficult students earned him great respect.
sentences.zh: 他對難相處的學生展現的寬容忍耐讓他贏得極大的尊敬。

words.defn_en: generosity or forgiveness toward a rival or less powerful person:

sentences.en: The victorious general treated his enemies with unexpected ______ .
sentences.zh: 這位得勝的將軍以出人意料的寬宏大量對待他的敵人。

sentences.en: His ______ toward his critics won him widespread admiration.
sentences.zh: 他對批評者展現的寬宏大量為他贏得了廣泛的欽佩。

words.defn_en: a lack of courage or determination; timidity:

sentences.en: His ______ prevented him from speaking up during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 他的怯懦讓他在這場危機中無法挺身發言。

sentences.en: The general condemned the soldiers' ______ in retreating without orders.
sentences.zh: 這位將軍譴責這些士兵未經命令就撤退的怯懦行為。

words.defn_en: showing a lack of courage or determination:

sentences.en: His ______ response to the challenge disappointed his supporters.
sentences.zh: 他對這項挑戰怯懦的回應讓他的支持者感到失望。

sentences.en: The senator was accused of a ______ refusal to take a clear stance.
sentences.zh: 這位參議員被指控怯懦地拒絕表明清楚的立場。

words.defn_en: fully in agreement, especially by all members of a group:

sentences.en: The decision was ______, with everyone agreeing on the solution.
sentences.zh: 這項決定獲得了全體一致的同意,每個人都認同這個解決方案。

sentences.en: The jury reached a ______ verdict after only two hours.
sentences.zh: 陪審團僅花了兩個小時就達成了一致的判決。
